newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Angola swears in unity government to end war era.
newsitem.headline: Angola swears in unity government to end war era.

text.p: Angola on Friday swore in a government of national unity bringing together former foes from 19 years of civil war, witnesses said.
"The formation of this government is another fundamental step in a long and difficult process of peace," President Eduardo Jose dos Santos said in a speech at the ceremony.
"Behind us lie thousands of dead, a devastated country and a semi-paralysed economy," dos Santos said.
He said establishment of the unity government, including four cabinet ministers from the rival UNITA movement of Jonas Savimbi, would not cure all the ills of the country.
"But it could make a definite contribution towards a better solution," dos Santos added.
